ideaDigest.title: Closed-die forged AA6082-T6 knuckle for peak fatigue
ideaDigest.description: For the loaded strut-type upright, adopt closed-die forged AA6082-T6 instead of casting where fatigue-critical or where a thinner, denser section is wanted.
